init.trigger: user asks to initialize or document codebase
init.desc: Generate CLAUDE.md with codebase architecture, conventions, commands

review.trigger: user asks to review PR or branch
review.desc: Multi-pass PR review; checks logic, style, security, tests

security-review.trigger: user asks security audit of current branch changes
security-review.desc: OWASP-focused audit of pending diffs; outputs risk-ranked findings

simplify.trigger: user asks to clean up or refactor changed code
simplify.desc: Review changed code for reuse/quality/efficiency, then fix issues

session-start-hook.trigger: user wants test/lint runners on session start (web Claude Code)
session-start-hook.desc: Create SessionStart hook ensuring project can run tests and linters

update-config.trigger: automated behavior requests ("when X", "allow Y", "set Z=val")
update-config.desc: Configure settings.json; handles hooks, permissions, env vars

keybindings-help.trigger: user wants to remap keys or add chord shortcuts

fewer-permission-prompts.desc: Scan transcripts → add bash/MCP allowlist to .claude/settings.json

loop.trigger: user wants recurring task (e.g. "check every 5m", "keep running X")
loop.desc: Run prompt or slash command on recurring interval (default 10m)

claude-api.trigger: code imports anthropic SDK; user asks about Claude API features
claude-api.desc: Build/debug Claude API apps; prompt caching, tool use, model migration

ultrareview.trigger: user says "ultrareview" or wants multi-agent review
ultrareview.desc: Parallel multi-agent cloud code review; no-arg=local branch, arg=GitHub PR
ultrareview.note: Billed; requires git repo; no GitHub remote needed for local mode

ultraplan.trigger: user wants cloud environment for complex planning
ultraplan.desc: Auto-create cloud worktrees/environments for multi-agent planning tasks

team-onboarding.desc: Generate onboarding guide from local Claude Code usage history/data

effort.trigger: user wants to adjust effort/quality level
effort.desc: Interactive slider for session effort level (also: CLAUDE_EFFORT env var)

powerup.trigger: user wants feature demos or to learn Claude Code features
powerup.desc: Interactive animated feature demos with lessons

tui.trigger: rendering looks flickery or user wants full-screen mode
tui.desc: Switch to flicker-free alt-screen TUI rendering (also: CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER)

focus.trigger: user wants compact view of conversation
focus.desc: Toggle focus view showing only: prompt + tool summary + final response

undo.trigger: user wants to undo last action
undo.desc: Alias for /rewind; undoes last assistant action

usage.trigger: user asks about token or cost statistics
usage.desc: Show token usage and cost stats (merged /cost + /stats)

theme.trigger: user wants to change or create visual theme
theme.desc: Create or switch custom color themes

color.desc: Set random session color (no args = random pick)
